item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Tehran Accuses U.S. of ‘Reckless’ Attacks After Exchange of Fire in Strait
item.description: A day after the sides traded attacks, Iran’s foreign minister said Washington was undermining diplomacy and the U.S. military said it had struck two oil tankers near an Iranian port.

item.title: Live Updates: U.K. Local Election Results Point to Big Losses for Starmer’s Party
item.description: With votes still being tallied, Prime Minister Keir Starmer took responsibility for Labour losing hundreds of municipal seats but insisted he would not resign.

item.title: U.A.E. Expels Pakistani Workers, as Pakistan’s Peacemaking Creates a Rift
item.description: As Pakistan mediates between the U.S. and Iran, its ties to the Emirates have deteriorated. Pakistani workers say they are now being sent home en masse.

item.title: German Leaders Clash With Spy Chiefs Over Domestic Threat From Iran
item.description: Intelligence agents have privately warned of the potential of hybrid attacks from Iran-linked groups. But political leaders, including Chancellor Friedrich Merz, have publicly played down the risk.

item.title: Even in Labour-Loyal Wales, Voters Are Looking to Other Parties
item.description: Opinion polls before the election suggested that the right-wing anti-immigration Reform U.K. party and the center-left Plaid Cymru would battle for the top spot in Wales.

item.title: Farage Celebrates Reform UK’s Strong Performance in Local Elections
item.description: In early results, Nigel Farage’s Reform U.K. party has won more than 400 council races across England.
